feature.name: secrets-app-selector-qualifiers
feature.summary: Group the Secrets page Application selector by root app + qualifier so nested sub-apps (IDM's autobk/notif/idmprtl/allctmpr, exampleApplications/exampleCoreServices) are directly selectable, resolve the qualifier synchronously on selection, and scope the Environment selector by the chosen app+qualifier to stop environment leakage across sibling sub-apps.

acceptance_criteria: Every distinct {appName, qualifier} pair discoverable by extractAppEnvPairs() is directly selectable in the Application dropdown, without an ambiguous-vault-response round-trip

A root app with no qualified entries (e.g. mlops, webapp01) renders exactly one option with value="{name}" (byte-for-byte identical to today), so option[value="{name}"] queries keep matching exactly once
A root app with at least one qualified entry renders one option per distinct qualifier as value="{name}::{qualifier}", grouped under <optgroup :label="name">

A root app with a mix of qualified and unqualified entries additionally renders a root-only option value="{name}::" in the same optgroup; a root app with only qualified entries renders no root-only option
Selecting a qualifier option sets selectedAppName and selectedQualifier synchronously in the @change handler, before any awaited API call resolves
Selecting a root-only option sets selectedQualifier = '' and isRootOnlySelected = true
loadApps()'s auto-select-first-app logic leaves the page in the 'unresolved' state (selectedQualifier = '', isRootOnlySelected = false), never 'root-only'
In the 'qualified' state, the Environment selector never shows an environment absent from that exact {app, qualifier} pair
In the 'root-only' state, the Environment selector shows only environments from entries with no qualifier field

resolveEnvironmentEligibility() (the multi-environment fan-out path used when selectedEnvironments.length > 1) passes selectedQualifier.value || undefined to api.getSecrets(...), mirroring resolveSecretMetadata(), so a pre-selected qualifier is never silently dropped for multi-environment submissions
In the 'unresolved' (auto-selected default) state, the Environment selector keeps showing the union of all sub-apps' environments for that root app, unchanged from today

Switching between qualifier options, or between a qualifier and root-only option, resets selectedEnvironments, vaults, selectedVaultDir, and qualifiers/selectedQualifier consistent with existing onAppNameChange() reset behavior
The existing 'Sub-application' fallback selector (rendered when qualifiers.length > 1) remains functionally unchanged as a safety net for residual ambiguity
No backend file, API endpoint, or data contract changes are introduced

user_stories.so_that: existing workflows and the current Bug 3 fix dedup behavior are not regressed

The existing 'Bug 3 fix' environment-dedup test continues to pass unchanged in this default state

ui_changes: Rebuild the Application <select> to render grouped <optgroup>/<option> entries keyed by root app name, using a composite option value encoding ({name}, {name}::{qualifier}, or {name}::)
Add a local selectorValue ref that the <select> binds to instead of selectedAppName directly
Add an isRootOnlySelected boolean ref to distinguish the root-only state from the default unresolved state

Extend filteredEnvironmentOptions's filter predicate to add the qualifier/root-only conditions from the design's state table, while leaving the unresolved-state behavior (union by app.name only) unchanged

Extend resolveEnvironmentEligibility() to pass selectedQualifier.value || undefined as the qualifier argument to api.getSecrets(...), mirroring resolveSecretMetadata(), so multi-environment fan-out selection benefits from a pre-selected qualifier instead of always receiving the full ambiguous-qualifier response

user_interactions.result: selectedAppName and selectedQualifier are set synchronously in the @change handler; downstream state resets per onAppNameChange()-equivalent logic
selectedAppName is set, selectedQualifier is cleared, isRootOnlySelected becomes true; downstream state resets
selectedAppName is set only; selectedQualifier stays '' and isRootOnlySelected stays false (unresolved state)

user_interactions.action: environment selector is opened after an app+qualifier choice
user_interactions.result: only environments valid for that exact {app, qualifier} (or unqualified entries, in root-only state) are shown

user_interactions.action: 2+ environments are multi-selected after choosing a qualifier (e.g. idm::autobk)
user_interactions.result: resolveEnvironmentEligibility() passes the selected qualifier to api.getSecrets(...) for each environment, so none are spuriously marked excluded as ambiguous

ui_changes: Add coverage for grouped <optgroup> rendering across root apps with no/some/all qualified entries
Add coverage asserting selectedQualifier is set synchronously on qualifier-option selection
Add coverage for environment scoping in qualified, root-only, and unresolved states
Add coverage for downstream state reset when switching between qualifier and root-only options
Keep the existing 'Bug 3 fix' and 'shared parent vault' named tests passing unchanged

schema.flat: "{name}" — root app with no qualified entries
schema.root_only: "{name}::" — only rendered when the same root name also has at least one unqualified entry

validation: Exactly one flat-value option per root app with zero qualified entries
Zero or one root-only option per root app (present only if an unqualified entry exists alongside qualified entries)

qualifier_selection_state.location: srcV2/pages/SecretsPage.vue (selectedQualifier existing ref + new isRootOnlySelected ref)

schema.unresolved: { selectedQualifier: '', isRootOnlySelected: false } — default/auto-selected state from loadApps()

validation: loadApps()'s auto-select-first-app path must never set isRootOnlySelected or derive selectedQualifier from apps.value[0].qualifier
Only the Application selector's @change handler may transition between the three states

flows.name: Select a nested sub-app qualifier directly
steps: User opens the Application selector and sees root apps grouped with their qualifier options under <optgroup>
User selects a "{name}::{qualifier}" option
The @change handler splits the composite value and sets selectedAppName + selectedQualifier synchronously
Downstream state (selectedEnvironments, vaults, selectedVaultDir) resets
filteredEnvironmentOptions recomputes, scoped to app.name === selectedAppName && app.qualifier === selectedQualifier
The existing watch(selectedQualifier) re-resolves vault metadata once an environment is chosen (single-environment case), without a prior ambiguous-vault round-trip

error_paths.error: resolveSecretMetadata() still returns multiple qualifiers for the chosen app+qualifier+environment
error_paths.handling: the existing 'Sub-application' fallback selector (qualifiers.length > 1) surfaces for final disambiguation, unchanged

flows.name: Multi-environment fan-out after selecting a qualifier
steps: User selects a "{name}::{qualifier}" option, setting selectedAppName + selectedQualifier synchronously
User multi-selects 2+ environments
The watch(selectedEnvironments) handler calls resolveEnvironmentEligibility() for each newly-added environment
resolveEnvironmentEligibility() passes selectedQualifier.value || undefined to api.getSecrets(...)

Each environment resolves to 'eligible' when the app+qualifier+environment combination has exactly one vault and qualifierCount <= 1, instead of always being marked 'excluded' due to the dropped qualifier

error_paths.error: the app+qualifier+environment combination still resolves to qualifierCount > 1 or vaultCount !== 1
error_paths.handling: that environment is marked 'excluded' with its existing reason message; other environments in the batch are unaffected

flows.name: Select a root-only option for a mixed root app
steps: User selects the "{name}::" option for a root app that has both qualified and unqualified entries
selectedAppName is set; selectedQualifier is cleared; isRootOnlySelected becomes true
Downstream state resets
filteredEnvironmentOptions recomputes, scoped to entries with no qualifier field only

flows.name: Default auto-selected (unresolved) state on page load
steps: loadApps() runs on mount and sets selectedAppName to apps.value[0].name only
selectedQualifier remains '' and isRootOnlySelected remains false (unresolved state)
filteredEnvironmentOptions falls back to filtering by app.name alone, exactly as today
This state persists until the user makes an explicit selector choice

error_scenarios.scenario: apps.value entry has qualifier as an empty string rather than undefined
error_scenarios.handling: Treat empty-string and undefined qualifier identically as 'no qualifier' when deciding whether a root-only option should render and when matching the root-only environment filter
error_scenarios.user_message: N/A (client-side data normalization, no user-facing error)

error_scenarios.scenario: Application selector rendered before apps.value has loaded (isLoadingApps still true)
error_scenarios.handling: Selector renders with no options; selectorValue stays empty; no reset handler is invoked and no exception is thrown

error_scenarios.scenario: resolveSecretMetadata() still returns qualifiers.length > 1 after a qualifier was pre-selected via the grouped selector
error_scenarios.handling: The existing 'Sub-application' fallback selector surfaces unchanged, letting the user resolve the residual ambiguity
error_scenarios.user_message: Existing 'Choose a sub-application.' field error / fallback selector label, unchanged

error_scenarios.scenario: User switches from a qualified selection to a different root app entirely
error_scenarios.handling: selectedQualifier and isRootOnlySelected both reset to their unresolved defaults ('' / false), consistent with existing onAppNameChange() reset behavior, before the new root app's own state is established
